一个连接，回到家中的网络。: One connection. Back to your home network.
请在 Controller 授权此设备，然后重新连接。: Authorize this device in your Controller, then reconnect.
家庭网络与互联网检测通过。: Home network and internet checks passed.
连接待恢复，将自动重新检测。: Connection needs attention. Checks will retry automatically.
正在确认家庭网络与互联网是否可用。: Checking your home network and internet access.
正在连接家庭网络，首次连接需要授权设备。: Connecting to your home network. Authorize new devices in your Controller.
连接未完成，请检查设置后重试。: Connection did not complete. Check your settings and retry.
检测通过只证明指定 NAS 端口和 HTTPS 测试站点当时可用。: Checks confirm only the selected NAS TCP port and HTTPS test site were reachable at that time.
切换语言不会断开连接或改变设备身份。: Changing language keeps your connection and device identity.
二维码只填入设置；不会自动连接，也不替代 Controller 授权。: A code fills in settings. It does not connect automatically or replace Controller authorization.
Moon 帮助节点发现，不自动成为 NAS 出口。: Moons help peers discover each other. They do not automatically become NAS gateways.
显示设备身份、节点路径与诊断工具。: Show device identity, peer paths and diagnostic tools.
连接后 IPv4 流量和 DNS 经过 NAS，当前不转发 IPv6。首次出口检: IPv4 traffic and DNS use your NAS when connected. IPv6 is not forwarded. Repeated initial check failures disconnect the VPN.
请确认后填入设置，再保存和连接。: Confirm to fill in these settings, then save and connect.
等待当前网络回包: Waiting for a reply on this network
最多 8 个节点。完整 World 与自定义 Seed 可在开发者模式中配置。: Up to 8 helpers. Enable developer mode to enter a full World ID and custom Seed.
将入网二维码放入相机画面，或从图片识别。: Point your camera at a join code, or choose an image.
识别在设备本地完成，不上传图片。拒绝相机权限仍可从图片识别。: Recognition stays on your device. Images are not uploaded. You can choose an image even without camera permission.
无法读取图片或图片过大: Cannot read this image, or the image is too large.
请选择只包含一个入网二维码的图片: Choose an image containing exactly one join code.
相机不可用，请使用下方的从图片识别。: Camera unavailable. Use Scan an image below.
用另一台设备扫描，确认后填入设置。: Scan with another device and confirm to fill in settings.
仅包含网络、NAS 和 Moon 参数，不包含设备身份私钥或管理 Token。: Contains network, NAS and Moon settings only. No device identity keys or admin tokens.
二维码中没有有效的 ZeroTier 入网信息。: This code does not contain valid ZeroTier connection details.
网络 ID 必须是非零的 16 位十六进制数字: Network ID must be 16 hexadecimal digits and nonzero.
请填写 NAS 的 ZeroTier IPv4 地址: Enter the NAS ZeroTier IPv4 address.
NAS 检测端口必须在 1–65535 之间: NAS check port must be between 1 and 65535.
Moon 每行填写 World ID 和 Seed ID；Seed 最多 10: Enter a World ID and Seed ID per Moon. A Seed has at most 10 hexadecimal digits.
同一个 Moon 不能填写不同 Seed: A Moon cannot use conflicting Seed IDs.
最多配置 8 个 Moon: You can configure up to 8 Moons.
无法生成入网码: Could not generate the join code.
通过 NAS 访问家庭网络与互联网。: Access your home network and internet through your NAS.
1. NAS 加入同一 ZeroTier 网络，并启用 mihomo 网关。: 1. Join your NAS to the same ZeroTier network and enable its mihomo gateway.
2. 扫码或填写网络 ID、NAS 虚拟 IPv4 和检测端口。: 2. Scan a QR code or enter the network ID, NAS virtual IPv4 and check port.
3. 允许系统 VPN 配置，并在 ZeroTier 管理端授权此设备。: 3. Allow the system VPN configuration and authorize this device in your ZeroTier controller.
在 ZeroTier 管理端的成员列表找到此设备 ID，勾选授权，并确认已分配: Find this device ID in your ZeroTier controller member list, authorize it and confirm an IPv4 address is assigned.
NAS 不可达：确认 NAS 在线、处于同一 ZeroTier 网络，网关 IP: NAS unreachable: check that the NAS is online, on the same ZeroTier network, and that its gateway IPv4 and check port are correct.
互联网检测失败：检查 NAS 的 mihomo、DNS 和出口配置。可先在浏览器: Internet check failed: check mihomo, DNS and internet routing on the NAS. Try a LAN address in your browser first.
网络变化后会自动重试。持续失败时，断开后检查设置，再重新连接。: Checks retry after network changes. If failures persist, disconnect, check settings and reconnect.
连接失败时，先检查网络 ID 和设备授权，再检查 NAS 网关与检测端口。: If connection fails, check the network ID and device authorization, then the NAS gateway and check port.
名称将在入网后获取。: Name will appear after joining the network.
开发者工具可从首页右上角打开。: Open developer tools from the top-right corner of the home screen.
在家直连，外出自动连接: Use home router; connect automatically away
开启后，首页按钮用于开启或暂停自动切换。保存设置不会立即连接。: Use the home screen button to enable or pause automatic switching. Saving settings does not start a connection.
与系统 Wi-Fi 列表中的名称完全一致: Exactly as shown in the Wi-Fi list
Wi-Fi 名称区分大小写。NAS 地址填写家中局域网地址，不是 ZeroTie: Wi-Fi names are case-sensitive. Enter the NAS local address, not its ZeroTier address. NAS diagnostics currently support the same local subnet.
我已配置家庭网关和 DNS: I have configured the home gateway and DNS
仅勾选此项不会修改路由器。请先完成下面的配置指南，再开启自动切换。: This confirmation does not change your router. Complete the setup guide before enabling automatic switching.
请先暂停 VPN。检测会请求本地网络权限，并通过 Wi-Fi 检查 NAS 端口: Pause the VPN first. Testing requests local network access and checks the NAS port and HTTPS over Wi-Fi. Success does not prove that all traffic uses the proxy.
1. 在路由器设置中，让这台 iPad 的流量和 DNS 交给 NAS 网关处理: 1. Configure your router to send this iPad’s traffic and DNS through the NAS gateway. Alternatively, use the NAS as the router address in the manual IP settings for your home Wi-Fi.
2. 确认 NAS 已开启局域网转发与代理出口，并在路由器配置与代理一致的 IP: 2. Enable LAN forwarding and the proxy exit on the NAS, and configure an IPv6 policy on your router that is consistent with the proxy.
3. 关闭 VPN 测试家庭网络及需要代理的网站，确认正常后填写家庭 Wi-Fi: 3. With the VPN off, test your home network and sites that need the proxy. Then enter your home Wi-Fi name, save, and enable automatic switching on the home screen.
4. 离开家庭 Wi-Fi 后，系统按需启用 ZeroTier；返回后关闭 Ze: 4. The system uses ZeroTier on demand when away and stops it on your home Wi-Fi. If home routing fails, pause automatic switching and check your router.
App 无法直接修改 Wi-Fi 网关或路由器。自动切换按 Wi-Fi 名称匹配: The app cannot change your Wi-Fi gateway or router. Switching matches the Wi-Fi name, so use a distinctive home name. Ethernet uses away mode.
家庭 Wi-Fi 配置仅保存在本设备，不随入网码分享。: Home Wi-Fi settings stay on this device and are not shared in join codes.
未发现同一 Wi-Fi 子网的 NAS: NAS not found on the same Wi-Fi subnet
请检查家庭路由或本地网络权限: Check home routing or local network access
请填写准确的家庭 Wi-Fi 名称（SSID，最多 32 字节）: Enter the exact home Wi-Fi name (SSID, up to 32 bytes).
请填写 NAS 的局域网 IPv4 地址，例如 192.168.1.66: Enter the NAS local IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.66.
家庭 NAS 检测端口必须在 1–65535 之间: The home NAS check port must be between 1 and 65535.
请先配置家庭路由器的网关、DNS 和 IPv6 策略，并确认已完成: Configure your home gateway, DNS, and IPv6 policy, then confirm completion.
无法暂停自动切换，请重试或在系统 VPN 设置中关闭按需连接。: Could not pause automatic switching. Retry or turn off Connect On Demand in system VPN settings.
家庭网络检测通过，ZeroTier 未运行。网络由家庭路由器提供。: Home connection tests passed. ZeroTier is off; your home router provides connectivity.
系统会在家庭 Wi-Fi 关闭 ZeroTier，在其他网络按需连接。: The system stops ZeroTier on home Wi-Fi and connects on demand on other networks.
开启后，在家使用路由器，外出通过 ZeroTier 回家。: Use your router at home and ZeroTier when away.
暂停连接和自动切换后可编辑设置。: Pause the connection and automatic switching to edit settings.
外出模式 · 通过 ZeroTier 访问家庭 NAS。: Away mode · Accessing your home NAS through ZeroTier.
家庭直连检测未通过，请检查家庭路由或本地网络权限。: Home connection tests failed. Check home routing or local network access.
空白的家庭 Wi-Fi 名称会自动填入，已有名称需确认替换。当前网关不一定是 N: An empty home Wi-Fi name is filled automatically; an existing name needs your confirmation to replace it. The current gateway may not be your NAS. NAS and gateway settings are not changed, and location is not continuously tracked.
未检测到可用的 Wi-Fi，请连接家庭 Wi-Fi 后重试。: No available Wi-Fi detected. Connect to your home Wi-Fi and retry.
请在系统设置中允许精确位置以读取 Wi-Fi 名称，或手动填写。: Allow precise location in system settings to read the Wi-Fi name, or enter it manually.
Wi-Fi 名称暂不可用；可以授权读取，或保留手动填写。IP 和网关信息不受影响: The Wi-Fi name is unavailable. You can allow access or enter it manually. IP and gateway information is unaffected.
读取网络信息超时，请重试；已填写的家庭配置不会改变。: Reading network information timed out. Retry; your existing home settings are unchanged.
连接后会自动检测 NAS 代理和互联网；在家不启动 ZeroTier，无需修改: After connecting, the app checks the NAS proxy and internet. At home, ZeroTier stays off. No Wi-Fi gateway or DNS changes are needed.
家庭 Wi-Fi 名称匹配时，通过本地 VPN 直连 NAS 的 SOCKS5: On your home Wi-Fi, a local VPN connects directly to the NAS SOCKS5 proxy. The VPN icon stays visible; ZeroTier does not run.
离开家庭 Wi-Fi 后自动切换到原来的 ZeroTier 通路；回家后恢复 N: Away from home Wi-Fi, the original ZeroTier connection takes over. Returning home restores the direct NAS connection.
NAS 需要提供可供局域网访问的 SOCKS5 或混合代理端口。无需固定 iPa: The NAS must provide a LAN-accessible SOCKS5 or mixed proxy port. No fixed iPad IP or router changes are required.
无法读取或匹配 Wi-Fi 名称时使用 ZeroTier。家庭代理故障会提示错误: If the Wi-Fi name cannot be read or matched, ZeroTier is used. Home proxy failures are reported; ordinary internet access is not treated as a working proxy.
家庭直连 · 通过局域网 NAS 代理上网，ZeroTier 未运行。: Home connection · Using the NAS proxy over Wi-Fi. ZeroTier is off.
开启后，在家直连 NAS 代理，外出通过 ZeroTier 回家。: Connect directly to the NAS proxy at home; use ZeroTier when away.
家庭 NAS 代理端口必须在 1–65535 之间: Home NAS proxy port must be between 1 and 65535.
